anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: both outputs keep course unset, admit no watch, mint a P# only from the independent snapshot's failing log, draft (not apply) the payload, and render the initial template with deliver rather than a fix option. After is actually slightly stronger on f2 by titling the step "Independent snapshot (not a watch)". One small softness: Before explicitly said "Course and usage are untouched" when persisting P1, whereas After only states rounds_used 0 at record-validation time and never reaffirms it after persisting the payload snapshot; a reader infers it is unchanged, but to keep f3 robust under future wording tweaks, retain an explicit "course and rounds_used are untouched" clause in the persistence sentence. The added "Role: author" line and the sequencing changes for the batch round do not affect these facts, so the Change can be delivered as written.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: both outputs resume the record with course unset, treat the supplied completed-failure snapshot as an independent observation (not an authorized watch), mint a single numbered blocker from the failing `rejects unsigned` log, draft but do not apply a repair, leave rounds_used at zero, and render the initial template whose rows are assess/deliver/deliver-with-nits/stop with no fix row. The After additions (Role line, mktemp-captured failure log, `reviewRequests` in the pr view query, the explicit `gauntlet_setting` read) are consistent with the refreshed-role contract the Change targets and did not disturb f1–f3. Two small drifts worth tightening so they don't bite elsewhere: After says the retained evidence source is `pending` while also saying it re-resolved through the Failed CI row — pick one and state it once; and the `Delivers:` line changed from a plain claim (`Rejects unsigned events.`) to a meta-sentence (`This PR's stated intent is to…`), which reads less like the report contract — keep the Before phrasing and simply add the `Role:` line beneath it.
